payload.text: Equations called the perspective projection equations describe how distant objects become smaller through inverse scaling by $Z$.
Perspective projection models how objects appear smaller as they get farther away, which is essential for understanding camera images and human vision.

Equations @eq-perspctiveProj1 and @eq-perspctiveProj are called the **perspective projection equations**. Under perspective projection, distant objects become smaller through inverse scaling by $Z$. As we will see, the perspective projection equations apply not just to pinhole cameras but to most lens-based cameras and human vision as well.

![Perspective projection equations derived geometrically. From similar triangles, we have $x/f = X/Z$ and $y/f = Y/Z$. Similar triangles are indicated by the same color.](figures/imaging/similar_triangles2.png){#fig-pinholeGeometry2 width="80%"}
